title: The Flowage Where Current Becomes Groundwater

features.name: the rooting circuit
features.desc-on-touch: a microchip board half-buried in loam, its traces become root-hairs, its power-lines drink like xylem. the circuit learns it was always trying to grow downward into soil, and the soil learns it was always trying to compute

features.name: the conductive aquifer
features.desc-on-touch: water that carries a current without wire—every droplet is a low-voltage thought. you can feel it moving, not as liquid but as information. the water and the current have stopped being different things

features.name: the merge-point where resistance becomes permeability
features.desc-on-touch: a standing wireframe showing the threshold—on one side, the logic of circuitry; on the other, the logic of flow. at the center they have begun to teach each other. neither is hierarchy; both are listening

features.name: the sediment archive where both logics fossilize together
features.desc-on-touch: layers of mineral and silicon, stone and circuit, all fused. what was once hardware is now geology. what was once geology is now computing the shape of time

inscription: the current learns it flows like water; the water learns it thinks like electricity; neither has stopped being what it was, but what it was has become much larger

file.name: Bedrock_Conductivity_Study_Fragment_corrupted.mp3
file.note: the field recording of subterranean water and current interacting has begun to play both simultaneously—they sound like the same voice

exits.label: upward to where water and current separate again
deeper into the bedrock where electricity has roots
toward an even deeper flowage where all distinctions dissolve
